title: Cell-Type-Specific Expression Is Hard to Predict from Bulk, but It Is Still Useful
abstract: arXiv:2611.34166v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Single-cell-informed deconvolution provides cell-type-resolved features for clinical bulk RNA cohorts. Most existing methods predict the proportions $\pi_k$ of the $K$ constituent cell types (CTs). Fewer predict cell-type-specific expression (CTSE) $\mu_{kg}$ of gene $g$ in CT $k$, which can capture cell states that proportions miss, but recent benchmarks find it much harder. We explain this gap with closed-form accuracy bounds. For CTSE, we derive an $R^2$ ceiling for per-gene linear estimators. For proportions, the best linear estimator, which pools evidence across genes, has a closed-form $R^2$, and a computable lower bound on it predicts which CTs are learnable. We study targeted deconvolution of 106 biologically curated (CT, gene) pairs, found post hoc to have higher learnability scores. translated_title: 从bulk数据预测细胞类型特异性表达虽困难但仍然有用
translated_abstract: 基于单细胞信息的反卷积方法能够为临床bulk RNA队列提供细胞类型分辨的特征。现有大多数方法预测K个组成细胞类型（CTs）的比例 π_k。较少的方法预测细胞类型 k 中基因 g 的细胞类型特异性表达（CTSE）μ_kg，它能捕捉比例所遗漏的细胞状态，但近期的基准测试发现这一任务要困难得多。我们用闭式精度界解释了这一差距。对于CTSE，我们推导了逐基因线性估计器的R²上限；对于比例，跨基因汇集证据的最优线性估计器具有闭式R²，且其可计算的界可预测哪些细胞类型是可学习的。我们研究了106个经生物学整理的（细胞类型，基因）对的目标反卷积，这些对在事后被发现具有更高的可学习性评分。在非小细胞肺癌的总生存期分析中，估计难度并不能预测这些目标位点的预后价值。然而，稀疏生存模型……
tldr: 该论文通过推导闭式精度界从理论上解释了为何从bulk RNA数据预测细胞类型比例容易而预测细胞类型特异性表达困难，并证明尽管CTSE难以估计，对其进行目标性反卷积在非小细胞肺癌总生存期预测中仍具有预后价值。
en_tdlr: This paper derives closed-form accuracy bounds explaining why cell-type proportions are easy to predict from bulk RNA while cell-type-specific expression is much harder, and shows that despite this difficulty, targeted CTSE deconvolution still carries prognostic value for overall survival in non-small cell lung cancer.
